nodes.name: MOBILE_RESPONSIVENESS_AUDIT.md
nodes.summary: Read-only mobile usability audit of the EOC React frontend at a narrow phone viewport. It catalogs layout, touch-target, table, and modal issues across several views, prioritizes fixes, and provides a CSS patch and verification checklist.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Brief starter documentation for the React and Vite frontend template. It links to the available React plugins, React Compiler guidance, and recommendations for expanding ESLint configuration.

nodes.name: fix-logo.bat
nodes.summary: Minimal Windows batch wrapper that invokes the frontend's logo-centering Node.js helper.

nodes.name: fix-logo.ps1
nodes.summary: PowerShell image-processing utility that parses PNG data, calculates the visible alpha-bounds center, shifts pixels horizontally, and rebuilds the image. It includes byte-order, CRC, and PNG filter helpers.

nodes.name: index.html
nodes.summary: HTML shell for the frontend, configured for Arabic right-to-left display with mobile metadata and app icons. A small inline script restores saved theme and language settings before mounting the React entry module.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Frontend npm manifest defining the Vite development, build, preview, lint, and test commands, along with React, mapping, animation, spreadsheet, and tooling dependencies.

nodes.name: vercel.json
nodes.summary: Vercel deployment configuration that rewrites requests to the SPA entry page, sets browser security and privacy response headers, and controls deployment for selected branches.
